group.title: A design review checklist
group.passage:
Woman: I have added the battery temperature results to the review package. Is anything else missing?
Man: We still need the mechanical team's confirmation of the cable clearance. The customer asked about it in the last meeting.
Woman: I will ask them now. If the confirmation arrives today, can we keep tomorrow's review?
Man: Yes. Otherwise, we should postpone the review rather than present an incomplete package.
group.passageZh:
女：我已把電池溫度測試結果加入審查資料。還缺什麼嗎？
男：我們仍需要機構團隊確認線材間隙。客戶在上次會議問過這件事。
女：我現在就去問。如果今天收到確認，我們能維持明天的審查嗎？
男：可以。否則應該延後審查，避免提交不完整的資料。
